metadata.scope: One attention layer, BF16, TP=1; QKV projections, per-head RMSNorm, cache writes, attention; sparse includes indexer projection + score + exact top-k. Excludes scheduler, metadata planning, full model and output projection.
metadata.prefill: Final chunk at target context length, fixed total query budget across batch; NOT full prompt latency
metadata.dense_kernel: FlashInfer paged FA2 prefill / tensor-core paged decode
metadata.sparse_kernel: SGLang autotuned Triton token-sparse GQA + fused grouped Lightning scores + FlashInfer exact top-k
metadata.cache: BF16, shuffled physical pages, independent request caches, L2 flushed before each timed sample
metadata.dense_workspace: 1 GiB for main KV heads=1; 128 MiB otherwise; allocated outside timing
